name: EPIC 220446201
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 15.1 solar radii and 0.89 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,065 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.89 solar masses and 15.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,738 K at its surface.
